products.short_description: Shut down pass-the-hash and credential theft on Windows 10/11 via Intune — Credential Guard (VBS), LSASS protection (RunAsPPL), WDigest off, Remote Credential Guard, WinRM RunAs off, and Windows LAPS — readiness-gated and pilot-first. Resolves ~3 common assessment findings. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop attackers harvesting credentials from your Windows endpoints

An intruder who lands on one Windows machine dumps LSASS for password hashes and Kerberos tickets, replays them with pass-the-hash / pass-the-ticket to move laterally, reads any plaintext WDigest cached, and reuses the identical local-admin password found on the first box to own the rest. This solution closes those doors on Windows 10/11 using Microsoft Intune only — no GPO, no third-party agent — and it resolves several common security-assessment findings directly (WinRM RunAs credential storage, unrestricted credential delegation, WDigest plaintext caching).

The six controls, in one coherent playbook

  • Windows Defender Credential Guard (VBS + LSA isolation, UEFI lock) — isolates secrets so even SYSTEM can't read them from LSASS.
  • LSASS protection / RunAsPPL (protected process, audit-first) — blocks the dumping tools.
  • WDigest disabled (UseLogonCredential = 0) — no reusable plaintext in memory.
  • Restrict credential delegation / Remote Credential Guard — protects credentials on outbound RDP.
  • WinRM DisableRunAs — removes a machine-stored credential.
  • Windows LAPS — unique, rotated local-admin password backed up to Entra ID.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered Intune steps with full navigation paths; every profile you create is named (Credential Guard - Pilot, LSASS Protection (RunAsPPL) - Pilot, WDigest Disabled - Baseline, Remote Credential Guard - Pilot, WinRM No RunAs Credentials - Baseline, Windows LAPS - Baseline) and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a readiness-gated, pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates; Credential Guard lands only on TPM/UEFI/Secure-Boot-capable hardware and LSASS protection is audited before enforcement.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the pass-the-hash attack chain and why each of the six controls exists; how Credential Guard (VBS), RunAsPPL, WDigest, Remote Credential Guard, WinRM, and Windows LAPS work; and the scope boundary against RDP-host hardening and full baselines.
  • Requirements Guide — hardware readiness (TPM 2.0 / UEFI / Secure Boot / virtualization), LAPS build + Entra feature, retrieval permissions, UEFI-lock rollback awareness — each with how to verify/implement.
  • Implementation Guide — six phases, click-by-click: assess readiness, configure Credential Guard, configure LSASS protection (audit-first), configure WDigest / Remote Credential Guard / WinRM, configure Windows LAPS, then pilot / validate / expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — readiness discovery (tenant + on-device TPM/UEFI/Secure Boot/VBS), per-device applied-state validation, a coverage report, safe remediation of the Credential Guard profile, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for readiness-gating, lock-mode rollout, and Windows LAPS operations.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

LSASS stops being a credential piñata: secrets isolated in VBS, LSASS a protected process, plaintext and machine-stored credentials gone, delegation restricted, and a unique rotated local-admin password on every device — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CREDGUARD-Discovery.ps1 — tenant + on-device (TPM/UEFI/Secure Boot/VBS) readiness check for credential-theft protection
    • CREDGUARD-Remediation.ps1 — safely create/assign the Credential Guard profile and preview the remaining controls
    • CREDGUARD-Report.ps1 — credential-protection coverage report for Windows devices
    • CREDGUARD-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for a credential-protection profile
    • CREDGUARD-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device applied state of a credential-protection profile

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
